newsitem.title: ITALY: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Tuesday September 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Tuesday September 3.

text.p: The following are some of the top headlines in leading Italian newspapers.
* A spokesperson for the European Commission says Padania, the state set up by seperatist party the Northern League, will not be included in the European Union. (All)
* Public works minister Antonio di Pietro says the government will invest 4-6 trillion lire in public water projects. A major part of these funds will go to building a dam in Campania. (Repubblica)
* Minister of Health Rosy Bindi comes under criticism for her plans to reduce Italy's national health service. (La Stampa)
* The Minister of Industry says electricity company ENEL, which is planned to be privatised in 1997, will have have a government watchdog authority to control prices. (Il Sole).
* Investment in the Italian media industry increases by 10 percent during the first half of 1996. (Il Sole).
* The debut of Eurosim on Monday, the European legislation which allows Italian share trading companies to operate in Europe and visa versa, causes alarm for Italian stock brokers. (Corriere)
Reuters has not verified these stories and can not vouch for their accuracy.
